title: Finite triangular continuation is invariant under admissible gauge changes

gauge_continuation.gauge_action: A'=A+d chi and phi'=exp(i e chi Q)phi, with real chi; Q commutes with the unitary multiplier and D'_mu phi'=exp(i e chi Q)D_mu phi
gauge_continuation.derivative_count: Each ordinary derivative falling on exp(i e chi Q) contributes one Q and derivatives of chi, so derivative order plus charge order is preserved by the same triangular filtration as K1386
gauge_continuation.admissible_class: On a finite interval, chi with bounded W^(R+2,infinity) spacetime coefficients and compatible initial traces acts as a bounded invertible map on X_R; the inverse is obtained from -chi
gauge_continuation.lorenz_residual: A gauge change preserves Lorenz gauge when box chi=0; a smooth gauge representative can be returned to Lorenz gauge on a finite interval by solving box chi=-partial^mu A_mu with compatible traces
gauge_continuation.continuation_invariance: Finite-time extendibility in one admissible representative is equivalent to finite-time extendibility in every representative connected by a gauge function with finite C_R(chi)
gauge_continuation.scope: This is gauge-orbit invariance of the analytic blow-up alternative, not construction of the physical quotient topology or a gauge-independent global norm
gauge_continuation.boundary: Singular gauge functions, global bundle topology, Gribov-type issues outside the Abelian trivial bundle and source-owned observation semantics are not classified
